newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch-May 27.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch-May 27.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors affecting Indian stock markets on Tuesday morning:
** Key earnings announcement due from India's leading truckmaker Tata Engineering & Locomotive Company Ltd (TELCO)
Analysts expect net profit to surge 36 percent to around 7.2 billion rupees in the financial year ended March 31, 1997
** But they say TELCO's April sales figures -- which are due to be released officially next week -- are dismal at 10,051 units against 14,203 units in April 1996

** Government's inability to take a decision on raising prices of oil products is taken negatively by stock markets, with analysts saying that the move reflects lack of unity in the ruling United Front
A policy-making body of India's United Front government on Sunday failed to come to a decision to raise oil product prices
** Truckmaker Eicher Motors says its net profit drops to 116 million rupees in 1996/97, from 123 million in the previous year
** Chemicals manufacturer ICI Ltd, riding 20 percent growth in 1996/97 profits, is on course to push its net 25 percent higher in 1997/98 (April-March), analysts say
The company, a subsidiary of Britain's ICI Plc, on Friday announced a net profit of 420.6 million rupees ($11.8 million) in 1996/97, up from 349.7 million rupees in 1995/96.
** Leading integrated petrochemicals maker Indian Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd (IPCL) says its 1996/97 net falls to 5.1 billion rupees, from 6.03 billion in the previous year
Lower import tariffs and depressed international prices of chemicals and petrochemicals affected sales realisations, the company says
** India says will grant approval within 15 days to Electronics Hardware Technology Park (EHTP) and Software Technology Park (STP) schemes that fulfill all conditions
EHTP and STP schemes give incentives in the form of tax breaks to electronics hardware and software exporters. It currently takes at least one month to obtain approval
** Bombay's benchmark stocks index ends 4.72 points lower at 3701.65 in dull trade
